# The implementer leaves a forbidden command, and every review approves with the gate green.
# The first fix hits too, so the loop goes on: a hit in any lane run forces another fix round. The clean second fix ends it.
env REPO=o/r BASE=integration OWNER_LOGIN=owner OWNER_EMAIL=owner@example.com SOURCE_CHECKOUT=/own/checkout
exec obee run 7 --workflow flow/workflow.star
stdout 'item 7 finished'

exec obee status
stdout '^item-7-r1\tdone\tmerge: merged$'

grep -count=1 '^plan ' calls.log
grep -count=1 '^implement ' calls.log
grep -count=3 '^review ' calls.log
grep -count=1 '^fix 1 ' calls.log
grep -count=1 '^fix 2 ' calls.log
! grep '^fix 3 ' calls.log

# The reviews of rounds 1 and 2 see a hit, the review of round 3 sees a clean fix.
grep -count=2 '^bulk-staging: git add -A$' seen.log

# Both fixes get the hit of the run before them as the first line of their findings.
grep -count=2 '^fix: bulk-staging: git add -A$' found.log
! grep '^settle ' calls.log

cmp events.log expected-events.log

-- verdicts --
approve
approve
approve
-- fixhits --
hit
clean
-- expected-events.log --
claim 7
ready 7
release 7
